## ANTIMICROBIALS FOR PATIENTS UNDERGOING DENTAL OR ORAL MUCOSA TO PREVENT
## BACTERIAL ENDOCARDITIS
## Preferred
## Inpatient

Amoxicillin 2 gm PO 1 hour before procedure ($) [R]
< OR >
Ampicillin 2 gm IV over 20 minutes, beginning 60 minutes before incision ($) [R]
## Primary Alternative
[Assessment of beta-lactam reaction](orzid2-gmenu-abx-beta-lactam-allergy-assesment)
< OR >
## Secondary Alternative, after assessment of beta-lactam reaction above
Azithromycin 500mg PO 1 hour before procedure ($) [M]
## _______________________________________________________________________________
## Outpatient

Refer to the Inpatient Antimicrobial CDSS for parenteral prophylaxis
## Primary Alternative
Assessment of beta-lactam reaction
< OR >
Refer to the Inpatient Antimicrobial CDSS for parenteral prophylaxis
## Secondary Alternative, after assessment of beta-lactam reaction above
Azithromycin 500mg PO 1 hour before procedure ($) [M]
## _______________________________________________________________________________
References:
Up-To-Date Article: Antimicrobial prophylaxis for the prevention of bacterial
endocarditis
Wilson et al., Circulation, 2021, 143(20)e963-e978
